Sell decreases deployed and increases net-token counter; negative deployed is allowed; no buy-style risk cap. CPI failures mapped to PumpSwapCpiFailed(6010). Reloads changed token balances and pool token accounts (pool itself not reloaded) before event. Event side 1 uses actual deltas, version and reserves; AMM event reserves omit virtual quote adjustment. Clock unwrap/plain arithmetic can panic; diagnostics not identical to original.

functions.conclusion: Burn ignores pause; requires end<=Clock and not Ended. Sets Ended only after events. Stored state.mint not independently compared to supplied mint.

functions.name: sweep_fees
functions.conclusion: No pause/rate test; trader updates per-recipient timestamp, admin does not. Per-call cap can be used repeatedly by authorized signer. Order determines which recipient is drained first.

functions.name: withdraw_quote_admin
functions.conclusion: Pause ignored; no quote allowlist; shared timestamp may throttle otherwise unrelated quote withdrawals.

functions.name: withdraw_admin
functions.conclusion: Gate bypassed if last==0 or interval==0. Negative configured interval can weaken delay. Pause ignored; does not reconcile deployed counters.

functions.name: extend_account
functions.conclusion: Permissionless extension; does not migrate logical fields or increment version. Trailing space is not a new state codec.

functions.name: initialize_fee_recipient
functions.conclusion: No stored-admin relationship required. Payer cannot choose fee recipient key independently of index.

functions.name: initialize_global_params
functions.conclusion: Sets only admin; trader stays zero, paused false. Bootstrap authority is not pinned.

functions.name: update_global_params
functions.conclusion: Version increments even with all None. Changes trade interval/reserve/risk and withdraw intervals but not roles, pause, sweep caps or deployed counters.

functions.name: update_admin
functions.conclusion: Replaces admin with arbitrary new_admin Pubkey. Single-step replacement; zero/unusable key can permanently lock administration. No acceptance signature, version bump or event.

functions.name: update_trader
functions.conclusion: Replaces trader with arbitrary new_trader Pubkey. New signer immediately controls all six trades and trader sweeps; zero key disables ordinary trading. Does not pause or reset counters.

functions.name: update_max_sol_per_sweep
functions.conclusion: Stores full u64 native sweep cap. Cap is per call, not time-based; admin sweep ignores it.

functions.name: update_max_stable_per_sweep
functions.conclusion: Stores full u64 nonnative sweep cap. One cap shared across all nonnative quote mints; admin sweep ignores it.

functions.name: reset_sol_deployed
functions.conclusion: Sets global signed SOL deployment counter to zero. Reopens global buy budget without withdrawing assets or resetting per-coin counters; can run while paused.

functions.name: reset_stable_deployed
functions.conclusion: Sets global signed stable deployment counter to zero. Reopens shared nonnative budget without moving tokens; future signed sell deltas can make it negative.

functions.name: reset_state
functions.conclusion: Clears reset_prefix, reset_middle, reset_stable_prefix/suffix and both deployed counters; sets paused=false. Preserves admin,trader,version,field_10,preserved_middle_a and both sweep caps. Clears withdrawal/trade intervals but not per-mint trade timestamp/state. Also resumes trading.

functions.name: stop_trading
functions.conclusion: Requires paused=false then writes true. Gates six trades; does not gate burns, withdrawals, sweeps or admin/reset.

functions.name: resume_trading
functions.conclusion: Requires paused=true then writes false. Repeated resume fails with TradingPaused (same code as repeated stop), despite active state.

functions.name: sweep_remaining
functions.conclusion: Exactly16 remaining accounts. Eight typed FeeRecipient/TokenAccount pairs; NO uniqueness/order/index<8/recipient PDA/ATA relationship check before helper use. Total starts0; each amount=min(available,cap-total) preserves total<=cap when subtraction valid. Rent subtraction and cumulative counter/destination additions are unchecked; previous+total-before_total may overflow intermediate. Configured max_sol_per_sweep or max_stable_per_sweep. Errors after prior transfers/exit need whole transaction rollback; saved duplicate pairs succeed, wrong bump/index succeed with zero tokens and reject at nonzero transfer. Event total is transferred raw units, not fee percentage.

functions.name: owner

state_and_events.name: SwapGlobalConfig

state_and_events.conclusion: Serialized254-byte prefix: admin49,trader81; signed sol113 and stable206; version162; caps174/246. Reset clears only named slices, pause and counters. Extend adds trailing64 without codec change. Opaque roles remain candidate behavioral labels.

state_and_events.name: UpdateGlobalParamsArgs
state_and_events.conclusion: Fixed16 optional fields with exact integer widths; tags/trailing instruction behavior comes from dependency deserializer. No semantic bounds imposed on option values.

state_and_events.name: GlobalParamsUpdateEvent

state_and_events.name: FeeRecipient

state_and_events.name: ExtendAccountEvent
state_and_events.conclusion: Explicit discriminator; account,user,old/new sizes,timestamp. Emitted only on actual growth, not no-op or funding failure.

state_and_events.name: SweepEvent
state_and_events.conclusion: Explicit discriminator; aggregate raw amount and timestamp only, not recipient/mint/authority. Consumers need transaction accounts to interpret asset.

state_and_events.name: MayhemState
state_and_events.conclusion: Serialized106-byte prefix; mint24, end16, two signed-candidate i128 at56/72, bool88,u64 time89,status97,burned98. State originates outside review; signedness/historical names not proven. Extend170 does not add interpreted fields.

state_and_events.name: BondingCurve

review_observations.title: Bootstrap and fee-recipient payer are permissionless
review_observations.status: candidate behavior established; vulnerability not established
review_observations.conclusion: Initialization of global parameters pins only a PDA, not an authorized bootstrap identity. Fee-recipient initialization checks no stored admin relation, confirmed by saved wrong-admin payer success. The latter creates program custody, so no payer theft established.
review_observations.unclosed: Current initialized deployment state, intended bootstrap policy and any hypothetical uninitialized-deployment reachability are absent.
review_observations.next_prerequisite: Parent supplies public deployment initialization/authority evidence; no new initialization probe.

review_observations.title: Sweep dynamic pairs are typed but not canonical or unique
review_observations.status: candidate control boundary established; fund-loss impact unproved
review_observations.conclusion: Eight arbitrary typed recipient/token pairs are accepted. Only nonzero token transfers exercise stored bump/index signing. Duplicate pairs serialize/reload in sequence and respect invocation cap; caller is already stored trader/admin. A zero token transfer does not validate ATA/mint/seeds.
review_observations.unclosed: Cannot prove creation of attacker-controlled Mayhem-owned FeeRecipient or a transfer into an unauthorized destination from missing constraints alone. Rent floor and cumulative counter bounds need reachable states.
review_observations.next_prerequisite: Use public state-origin and existing saved-case provenance to establish legal recipient universe and balances; preserve initializer exclusion.

review_observations.title: Shared nonnative risk/caps have raw-unit semantics
review_observations.status: candidate arithmetic fact; economic impact unproved
review_observations.conclusion: All nonnative quotes use one stable_deployed and common limits without mint decimals or unit normalization. Mayhem does not locally impose quote allowlist or pool-to-mint relationship beyond described constraints; fixed Pump/AMM CPI must provide missing relationships.
review_observations.unclosed: Supported live quote set, decimals, CPI configuration and actual route reachability are not established. No mixed-asset risk bypass claimed.
review_observations.next_prerequisite: Retained matching external-program source/configuration and public quote policy before economic conclusions; excluded Pump sell_v2 remains out of scope.

review_observations.title: Arithmetic failures are bounded rejection behavior, not proved exploits
review_observations.status: candidate failure conditions established; harmful reachable preconditions unproved
review_observations.conclusion: Release overflow checks are enabled. Unbounded retained bps can underflow, zero quote reserves can reach checked_div.unwrap, signed time additions can overflow, sweep rent subtraction can underflow, and previous+total-before_total can overflow before subtraction. Buy risk compares positive i128 low-u64 limbs. Some failures have matching saved synthetic receipts.
review_observations.unclosed: Authorized caller/configuration or legal state constraints matter; no unauthenticated persistent denial or fund loss established. External supply/fee and lifecycle invariants are unproved.
review_observations.next_prerequisite: Prove reachable balances/counters/configurations from permitted public evidence before assigning severity or proposing source changes.

review_observations.title: AMM native accounting includes WSOL closure rent and existing balance
review_observations.status: candidate source behavior and saved verification metadata; not a new exploit finding
review_observations.conclusion: Snapshot sol-vault before AMM then close entire WSOL quote account to it. Buy measured spend can be reduced by returned rent/preexisting WSOL; small buy may unsigned-underflow and abort. Sell receipt includes all returned WSOL/rent. No separate asset-only adjustment.
review_observations.unclosed: Existing published cases establish a bounded reconstruction behavior, not all native balance states. New security impact and policy mismatch are unproved.
review_observations.next_prerequisite: Parent evaluates rent/accounting policy against retained known cases; no new fixtures or probes.

review_observations.title: Pause and resets are narrower than all asset movement
review_observations.status: candidate privilege semantics established; no unauthorized access established
review_observations.conclusion: Stop gates trades only. Admin withdrawal, both sweeps and permissionless expired burn remain available. Reset_state clears intervals/counters and unpauses but preserves authorities/version/sweep caps and per-mint state. Single-step role changes accept unusable pubkeys.
review_observations.unclosed: Intended emergency/rotation/reset policy not given. These behaviors are admin-authorized or time-guarded, not privilege bypass by themselves.
review_observations.next_prerequisite: Compare to explicit responsible-owner operational policy before classifying a defect.
